title: A YouTuber played my game two days in a row
author: Quirky_Ad1993
selftext:
I shared my game here a while ago and got a lot of really nice comments, thanks again for that. It's a survivors-like where you control a whole party of heroes.

I reached out to **Broken's Playz** about the playtest, and he played it, then came back and played it again the next day. It's the first time a YouTuber has played my game, and it felt really good to see.

The first video is a lot of fun, he goes in completely blind. In the second one he gets the hang of it and pushes much further.

First video: [I Tried This New Party Based Bullet Heaven... It Is An Absolute Blast!! | Harmony Strike](https://youtu.be/lpT0RkDLNaI?si=lvMoMOiViuu0GiEO)

I'm still working on the game, reworking the boss attacks and adding a new mechanics. Once the playtests are done, I'll release the demo.
